messages:
Tara: Quick flag from usability: in the compact lists the action cell (kebab + optional icon) is hard to hit when checkboxes are visible. Users missed the menu twice.
Ben: Thanks. Which page and density?
Tara: Incidents table, compact density. The action area visually sits flush to the cell edge and the click target is ~18px.
Ivy: Can we add a non-visual hitpad so the icon stays the same but the interactive area increases? Something like `--action-hitpad-compact: 6px`.
Sam: Yep. Implementation idea: keep icon 20px but use padding to hit 32px target: `.action-btn { width:20px; height:20px; padding:var(--action-hitpad-compact); box-sizing:content-box; }`
Tara: Accessibility notes: touch target 44px for mobile, desktop 32px OK. Make sure button has `aria-haspopup=\"menu\"` and an SR label: "Actions for <item title>".
Ben: Also toasts from these actions are appearing under the sticky header and briefly obscure the filter chips. Copy is terse: just "Removed". Let's standardize: `"<Verb> <object> — Undo"` (e.g., "Removed 1 incident — Undo"). Anchor toasts to page frame bottom-right on dense list pages.
Ivy: Do we have a per-page toast anchor token? I don't think so. Maybe add `--toast-anchor-bottom` and a `.page-toasts` container that pages can opt into.
Sam: If we render toasts inside `.page-frame { position:relative }` then `.page-toasts { position:absolute; right:24px; bottom:var(--toast-anchor-bottom,24px); }` avoids header overlap. For SR announce use `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"`.
ci-bot: Build preview: https://ci/redwood/preview/incident-actions (branch: feat/compact-hitpad).
Ben: Keyboard flow: Tab -> row -> Tab -> actions -> Enter to open. If menu is portalled to body, remember to return focus to the kebab when closed. Use `role=\"menu\"` and `role=\"menuitem\"` on items.
Tara: Copy guidance for menu items: sentence case, verb-first: "Resolve incident", "Duplicate incident". Toasts: full phrase + undo.
Ivy: I'll add a tiny token PR: `tokens/interaction:add action-hitpad-compact=6px` and update Figma with a small overlay frame showing the invisible hitpad.
Sam: I'll add a Storybook story for compact table with sticky filters and include an a11y test for toast overlap.
Tara: I'll run 6 quick hallway tests tomorrow to validate discoverability, keyboard flow, and toast placement. If green we'll ship the token + toast container tweak this sprint. :thumbsup:
